name: Ada Murphy
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: “I still remember turning my exam desk toward the one classroom window.” Thursday often includes a stop at Ferris Deli, where Ada asks for the end slice and listens to the names the counter workers use for regulars.
voice: I can do sums if I face a window. Facing the board takes me right back to the day I stopped going.
appearance: Ada has a scattering of freckles across the bridge of the nose. Look for gray hair trimmed very close behind the ears. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a moss-green cardigan with a copper-colored clasp that has been repaired by hand. In conversation Ada looks at people's hands before looking at what they carry.
personality: Ada treats a small promise with the gravity others reserve for a contract. This makes Ada lovely to rely on and surprisingly difficult to invite on a whim.
agenda: To take the exam facing the window.
family: Ellen Avila is Ada’s first cousin once removed. Ada can always ask for five minutes alone. Ellen asks before bringing somebody along. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *A play in a pocket*, Ellen says, “I came to supervise the children and got cast as a lost umbrella.”
connections: Grace Reeves (class tutor). The tutor can change the seat without making the oldest learner explain school in front of the class.

reactions.situation: An older learner freezes in front of the blackboard
reactions.response: Ada offers to turn the learner's chair without announcing the reason to the class.

reactions.situation: Someone offers a cash reward for naming a rumored culprit
reactions.response: Ada asks what evidence supports the accusation and declines to supply a name on gossip alone.

reactions.situation: When offered a favor with ambiguous terms
reactions.response: Ada says what can be returned and asks whether that will do.
